title: Add Microsoft apps view to AppSource product list (Fix ADO #642217)
summary: A new predefined view called "Microsoft apps" was added to the AppSource Product List page to let customers quickly filter and browse only Microsoft-published applications.
key_points: Added a new view filtered to show only apps where PublisherType equals Microsoft
Customers can now access Microsoft apps with a single click instead of manually applying filters
The change is purely additive and follows existing page view patterns
No code paths or behavior changes affect existing functionality
